ValidationRule.description: If Open_to_Public__c field value is "No," Drive_Keyword__c must have a value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Open_to_Public__c), ISCHANGED(Drive_Keyword__c), ISNEW() ), ISPICKVAL(Open_to_Public__c, "No"), ISBLANK(Drive_Keyword__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Drive Keyword must be entered if a Drive is not open to the public.
